# Know Your Meme

> > The internet's definitive encyclopedia of viral memes, trends, and online culture, documenting everything from TikTok dances to exploitable image macros.

Know Your Meme is a comprehensive database that researches, documents, and explains the origins and evolution of internet memes, viral videos, and digital culture phenomena. The site features meme entries, editorial guides, and curated collections covering platforms like TikTok, Twitter, Reddit, and DeviantArt.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends
- Viral videos
- Exploitable memes
- Image macros
- Catchphrases
- Dance memes
- Meme explanations
- Internet culture
- Social media virality
- Nostalgia memes
- Reddit communities
- DeviantArt culture
- Breaking Bad references
- 90s hood movies
- Mental health humor

## Meme Entries

- [Jesse, What the Fuck Are You Talking About](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/jesse-what-the-fuck-are-you-talking-about): Breaking Bad dialogue meme featuring Walter White & Jesse Pinkman
- [We Still Talk About You](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme from DeviantArt art by t-a-t-k-a, viral on TikTok
- [I'm Talking About Innit](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend from BunnaB & YKNiece's Atlanta rap song 'Innit'

## Editorial Guides & Explainers

- [What Do The Memes About Hearing Saxophones In The Hood Mean?](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/what-do-the-memes-about-hearing-saxophones-in-the-hood-mean-the-viral-90s-hood-movie-trend-explained): Explainer on Boyz n the Hood saxophone meme trend by Phillip Hamilton
- [Who Is The 'Bananas And Rice' Girl?](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/who-is-the-bananas-and-rice-girl-the-viral-memes-about-somali-american-ice-victim-nasra-ahmed-explained): Guide to Nasra Ahmed viral ICE detention incident memes from Minneapolis

## Meme Collections

- [22 Memes About Mental Health That Are A Little Too Relatable](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/collections/22-memes-about-mental-health-that-are-a-little-too-relatable): Collection of 22 relatable mental health & depression humor memes from Reddit
